title: Kotoura-san: Haruka no Heya
justification: AniList 16636 is the ONA 'Haruka no Heya', 6 episodes, 2012-12-07 to 2013-01-11. AniDB 9394 S1-S6 are 'Haruka's Room 1..6' on 2012-12-07, 12-14, 12-21, 12-28, 2013-01-04, 01-11; TVDB 264049 0x01-0x06 and TMDB tv/53594 S0E1-6 are 'Haruka's Room 01..06' on the same dates. S7 'Special Loop' (undated) is another item.
